title: Webb makes Mario band leader; Bob Alexander's arrangements
summary: Webb announces Bauza will call the shots, and arranger Alexander writes Liza for him; Charlie Dixon writes the hard charts.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: So I keep -- all right, I keep listening to the guy. About six months later, one day -- I never forget it -- he call rehearsal for the band. And that day everybody's seated on the stand. After work he say, fellows, I want to announce something today. Starting today the man in charge to call the shots, top of the band, the rest of the band is MariO. To me that was the biggest thing that ever happened in my life. And I didn't know what to do. I said, Chick, I said (inaudible). Go ahead and lead (inaudible).

So I started calling numbers (inaudible) got rehearsing. All right, everything went beautiful (inaudible) he got hold of some of the arrangement and call it (inaudible) listen this kid play all night. I want you to arrange a number for him, such and such a number.

He called a different writer he used to have, a guy named Alexander. (Inaudible) in the band, Ron Alexander. (Inaudible) MariO, you may not get a chance. I say (inaudible) something and let me try. I'll get it in the rehearsal. Let me try. If the man like, you start, maybe he go give you work. So he made an arrangement for the band. He made "Liza." We recorded it. Chick went crazy.
He started getting work -- some -- order some for me, for me to play. He had another guy named Charlie Dixon used to write for him. Charlie wrote the hard stuff.
